The '''DH-X heavy blaster rifle''' was a long-ranged model of long-range [[Heavy blaster rifle/Legends|heavy blaster rifle]] produced by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]]. The design included a scope, a stock and a [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]] point below and behind the barrel. It was particularly popular with [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] who favored heavy weaponry, and saw large amounts of use during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. As the largest heavy [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] that Blastech produced<ref name="DC" /> it was fairly cumbersome and slow firing, but was capable of dropping most foes in a single blast.<ref name="DC" /> The weapon cost a total of 1,980 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and was thought to fill the niche between [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] rifles and [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blasters]].<ref name="DC" />

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The DH-X was first shown in ''[[Dangerous Covenants]]'' a sourcebook released in [[2014]] for the ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying game produced by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].
